name: Japan Discovery
stops: Tsukiji Outer Market, Meiji Shrine, free day
Fushimi Inari, Golden Pavilion, free day
Bullet train in, free day, fly home

days_detail.title: Australia – Tokyo
days_detail.text: Fly to Tokyo, transfer to hotel.
days_detail.detail: Depart Australia on the overnight flight to Tokyo. On arrival you're met and transferred to the hotel; the rest of the day is free to settle in.

days_detail.title: Tokyo sightseeing, free afternoon
days_detail.text: Morning at Tsukiji Outer Market and Meiji Shrine; afternoon free.
days_detail.detail: A morning of the classic Tokyo pairing: the food stalls and knife shops of the Tsukiji Outer Market, then the forested calm of Meiji Shrine. The afternoon is yours.
days_detail.optional: Tokyo Tower and city tour

days_detail.title: Tokyo free day
days_detail.text: Free day, or an optional Hakone day trip.
days_detail.detail: A full free day. Good choices are Asakusa and Senso-ji, teamLab, or a Shinjuku evening.
days_detail.optional: Hakone day trip: Lake Ashi cruise, Owakudani volcanic valley and the Open-Air Museum

days_detail.title: Tokyo – Mt Fuji – Nagano
days_detail.text: Drive to Mt Fuji's 5th Station and the Five Lakes, then on to the Nagano region.
days_detail.detail: Leave Tokyo for Mt Fuji, climbing by coach to the 5th Station at about 2,300 m (weather permitting) with views across the Fuji Five Lakes. Continue north to the Nagano region for the night.

days_detail.title: Nagano – Narai-juku – Takayama
days_detail.text: Wasabi farm, the Edo-era post town of Narai-juku, then Takayama's old town.
days_detail.detail: Start at a working wasabi farm, then walk the wooden main street of Narai-juku, one of the best-preserved post towns on the old Nakasendo trail. Arrive in Takayama with time to wander the merchant district of Sanmachi Suji.

days_detail.title: Takayama – Kyoto
days_detail.text: Drive to Kyoto for Fushimi Inari and the Golden Pavilion.
days_detail.detail: Head south-west to Kyoto. Walk part of the vermilion tunnel of torii at Fushimi Inari, then visit the Golden Pavilion (Kinkaku-ji) before checking in.
days_detail.optional: Evening Maiko dinner show

days_detail.title: Kyoto free day
days_detail.text: Free day, or an optional trip to the Kyoto coast.
days_detail.detail: A free day in Kyoto. Arashiyama's bamboo grove, Nijo Castle, Gion at dusk or a Nara day trip are all easy on your own.
days_detail.optional: 'Kyoto by the Sea': Amanohashidate sandbar and the boathouses of Ine

days_detail.title: Kyoto – Okayama – Hiroshima
days_detail.text: Kurashiki's canal quarter and Korakuen garden en route to Hiroshima.
days_detail.detail: Travel west via Okayama. Stroll Kurashiki's willow-lined canal and white-walled storehouses, then Korakuen, one of Japan's three great landscape gardens, before continuing to Hiroshima.

days_detail.title: Hiroshima & Miyajima
days_detail.text: Boat to Miyajima's floating torii, then the Peace Memorial Park.
days_detail.detail: Ferry to Miyajima to see Itsukushima Shrine and its torii standing in the water (tide permitting). Back in the city, visit the Peace Memorial Park and Museum and the A-Bomb Dome.

days_detail.title: Hiroshima – Osaka by bullet train
days_detail.text: Shinkansen from Himeji to Shin-Kobe, then on to Osaka.
days_detail.detail: Coach to Himeji station, then board the Shinkansen for a short bullet-train ride to Shin-Kobe before continuing to Osaka.

days_detail.title: Osaka free day
days_detail.text: Free day in Osaka.
days_detail.detail: Free day. Dotonbori's neon and street food, Osaka Castle, or a day trip to Nara are the usual picks.

days_detail.title: Depart Osaka
days_detail.text: Transfer to the airport for the flight home.
days_detail.detail: Transfer to Kansai Airport for the flight back to Australia.

days_detail.title: Arrive Australia
days_detail.detail: Arrive home.

name: Warriors of China
stops: Tiananmen Square, Forbidden City, Great Wall at Juyong Pass
Terracotta Warriors, Small Wild Goose Pagoda
Meijiawu tea village, West Lake, The Bund

images.caption: Stand in awe of the Terracotta Warriors in Xi'an
Admire the Great Wall of China
Visit Luoyang to explore the famed Longmen Grottoes
Wander through Tiananmen Square in Beijing

days_detail.title: Australia – Beijing
days_detail.text: Fly to Beijing and transfer to the hotel.
days_detail.detail: Depart Australia for Beijing. Meet your guide on arrival and transfer to the hotel.

days_detail.title: Tiananmen Square & Forbidden City
days_detail.text: Tiananmen Square and the Forbidden City (or Temple of Heaven).
days_detail.detail: Walk Tiananmen Square and into the Forbidden City's succession of courtyards and halls (the Temple of Heaven substitutes on days the palace is closed).
days_detail.optional: Summer Palace and a panda visit

days_detail.title: Great Wall of China
days_detail.text: Great Wall at Juyong Pass.
days_detail.detail: Visit a jade museum, have a picnic lunch, then climb a section of the Great Wall at Juyong Pass, one of the wall's great fortified gateways.
days_detail.optional: Hutong pedicab tour with a local family visit

days_detail.title: Beijing – Xi'an
days_detail.text: High-speed train or flight to Xi'an.
days_detail.detail: A morning visit to a traditional Chinese medicine centre, then travel to Xi'an by high-speed rail (about four and a half hours) or flight depending on departure.

days_detail.title: Terracotta Warriors
days_detail.text: The Terracotta Warriors and Horses Museum.
days_detail.detail: The day belongs to the Terracotta Army: the three excavation pits and the bronze chariots, with time in the museum halls.
days_detail.optional: Tang Dynasty music and dance show with dumpling dinner

days_detail.title: Xi'an – Luoyang
days_detail.text: Small Wild Goose Pagoda, then train to Luoyang.
days_detail.detail: See the Small Wild Goose Pagoda before boarding the high-speed train to Luoyang, the ancient capital on the Luo River. Group dinner tonight.

days_detail.title: Longmen Grottoes – Zhengzhou
days_detail.text: Longmen Grottoes, then on to Zhengzhou.
days_detail.detail: Spend the morning at the Longmen Grottoes, where some 100,000 Buddhist figures are carved into the limestone cliffs above the river. Continue to Zhengzhou.

days_detail.title: Zhengzhou at leisure
days_detail.text: Free day, or the Shaolin Temple.
days_detail.detail: A day to rest, or take the optional trip to the Shaolin Temple, birthplace of kung fu, with a martial-arts performance.
days_detail.optional: Shaolin Temple and kung fu show

days_detail.title: Zhengzhou – Wuxi
days_detail.text: Zhengzhou Museum, then high-speed train to Wuxi.
days_detail.detail: Visit the Zhengzhou Museum in the morning, then a long high-speed rail leg south-east to Wuxi on the shores of Lake Tai.

days_detail.title: Wuxi – Suzhou
days_detail.text: Lihu Park and a pearl factory, then Suzhou.
days_detail.detail: Walk Lihu Park on the lakeside and visit a freshwater pearl workshop, then a short drive to Suzhou.

days_detail.title: Suzhou – Hangzhou
days_detail.text: Lingering Garden and a silk factory; Tangxi Ancient Town.
days_detail.detail: Suzhou's Lingering Garden and a silk factory in the morning, then Tangxi Ancient Town's canals on the way to Hangzhou.

days_detail.title: Hangzhou – Shanghai
days_detail.text: Tea village, West Lake boat ride, then Shanghai's Bund.
days_detail.detail: Visit Meijiawu tea village in the Longjing hills and cruise West Lake, then travel to Shanghai for an evening on the Bund.

days_detail.title: Shanghai History Museum
days_detail.text: Museum morning; afternoon free.
days_detail.detail: Shanghai History Museum in the morning; the afternoon is free.
days_detail.optional: Half-day city tour, or a Huangpu River night cruise

days_detail.title: Shanghai – Australia
days_detail.text: Transfer to the airport for the flight home.
days_detail.detail: Transfer to Pudong Airport for the flight back to Australia.

days_detail.title: Arrive Australia
days_detail.detail: Arrive home.

name: Unbelievable Japan
stops: Arrive; free day or Hiroshima option
Toyota museum en route; Tsukiji and Meiji Shrine

images.caption: Mount Fuji, Japan's tallest and most iconic peak
Akihabara, Tokyo's technology and anime district

days_detail.title: Australia – Osaka
days_detail.text: Fly to Osaka and transfer to the hotel.
days_detail.detail: Fly to Osaka (usually via China; some departures leave a day early). Transfer to the hotel on arrival.
days_detail.hotel: Hotel Sobial Osaka Dome or similar

days_detail.title: Osaka free day
days_detail.text: Free day, or the optional Hiroshima trip.
days_detail.detail: A free day in Osaka. The optional Hiroshima trip goes by bullet train, ferries to Miyajima for Itsukushima Shrine, then visits the Peace Memorial Park and A-Bomb Dome before returning.
days_detail.hotel: Hotel Sobial Osaka Dome or similar
days_detail.optional: Hiroshima & Miyajima full-day trip by bullet train

days_detail.title: Osaka – Kyoto – Nagoya
days_detail.text: Kiyomizu-dera, free time in Kyoto, then on to Nagoya.
days_detail.detail: Drive to Kyoto for Kiyomizu-dera and its wooden stage above the hillside, then free time in the old capital (or an optional half-day tour) before continuing to Nagoya in the evening. About 200 km.
days_detail.optional: Kyoto half-day: Fushimi Inari, Golden Pavilion, Arashiyama bamboo grove

days_detail.title: Nagoya free day
days_detail.text: Free day, or Shirakawa-go and Takayama.
days_detail.detail: Free day, or the optional 380 km round trip to the thatched farmhouses of Shirakawa-go, Takayama's old town and a Japanese knife museum.
days_detail.optional: Shirakawa-go, Takayama & Japanese Knife Museum

days_detail.title: Nagoya – Tokyo
days_detail.text: Toyota Commemorative Museum, then drive to Tokyo.
days_detail.detail: Visit the Toyota Commemorative Museum of Industry and Technology in the original 1911 factory buildings, then drive about 360 km to Tokyo.

days_detail.title: Tokyo sightseeing
days_detail.text: Tsukiji Outer Market and Meiji Shrine; afternoon free.
days_detail.detail: Morning tour of the Tsukiji Outer Market and Meiji Shrine's gardens. Afternoon free, or the optional tour taking in Tokyo Tower, Shinjuku and Shibuya Crossing.
days_detail.optional: Tokyo afternoon tour with Tokyo Tower

days_detail.title: Tokyo – Mt Fuji – Aichi
days_detail.text: Mt Fuji's 5th Station and the Five Lakes, then Aichi Prefecture.
days_detail.detail: Drive to Mt Fuji's 5th Station at 2,300 m for views over the Fuji Five Lakes, then continue to Aichi Prefecture for the night. About 420 km.

days_detail.title: Aichi – Osaka – Australia
days_detail.text: Early drive to Osaka for the flight home.
days_detail.detail: Early departure for the 250 km drive to Osaka and the afternoon flight home.

days_detail.title: Arrive Australia
days_detail.detail: Arrive home.

name: Best of Japan
stops: Fushimi Inari, Golden Pavilion; free day
Bullet train Himeji–Okayama, then coach; Miyajima
Kumamoto Castle, Yanagawa canals, Dazaifu; free day

images.caption: Mt Fuji from the Five Lakes area
Umi Jigoku, one of the Hells of Beppu

days_detail.title: Australia – Tokyo
days_detail.text: Fly to Tokyo and transfer to the hotel.
days_detail.detail: Fly to Tokyo (direct not guaranteed) and transfer to the hotel.

days_detail.title: Tokyo sightseeing
days_detail.text: Tsukiji Outer Market and Meiji Shrine; afternoon free.
days_detail.detail: A morning at the Tsukiji Outer Market and Meiji Shrine's gardens, then a free afternoon or the optional tour with Tokyo Tower, Shinjuku and Shibuya Crossing.
days_detail.optional: Tokyo afternoon tour with Tokyo Tower (¥8,000)

days_detail.title: Tokyo free day
days_detail.text: Free day, or Hakone.
days_detail.detail: A free day, or the optional Hakone trip: Lake Ashi cruise, cable car to the Owakudani sulphur vents, and the Open-Air Museum.
days_detail.optional: Hakone day tour (¥15,000)

days_detail.title: Tokyo – Mt Fuji – Nagano
days_detail.text: Mt Fuji's 5th Station and the Five Lakes, then the Japanese Alps.
days_detail.detail: About 370 km: up to Mt Fuji's 5th Station at 2,300 m, the Five Lakes, then inland to the Nagano region.
days_detail.hotel: Hotel Route Inn Suwa Inter or similar, Nagano region

days_detail.title: Nagano – Narai-juku – Takayama
days_detail.text: Wasabi farm, an Edo post town, then Takayama.
days_detail.detail: A wasabi farm fed by Alpine spring water, the preserved Edo-period post town of Narai-juku, then Takayama's old town (a Gifu hotel may substitute).

days_detail.title: Takayama – Kyoto
days_detail.text: Fushimi Inari and the Golden Pavilion.
days_detail.detail: Drive 270 km to Kyoto for a half-day tour: the torii tunnels of Fushimi Inari and the gold-leaf Kinkaku-ji. Evening free.
days_detail.optional: Maiko dinner show in Gion (¥35,000)

days_detail.title: Kyoto free day
days_detail.text: Free day, or 'Kyoto by the Sea'.
days_detail.detail: Free day, or the optional 250 km trip to the Amanohashidate sandbar, the boathouses of Ine and the thatched village of Miyama.
days_detail.optional: Kyoto by the Sea day tour (¥15,000)

days_detail.title: Kyoto – Nara – Osaka
days_detail.text: Nara's bowing deer, then Dotonbori.
days_detail.detail: Nara Park and its thousand sacred deer, then Osaka's Shinsaibashi and Dotonbori districts at leisure. About 90 km.
days_detail.hotel: Hotel Sobial Osaka Dome or similar

days_detail.title: Osaka – Himeji – bullet train – Hiroshima
days_detail.text: Sake brewery, Himeji Castle, Shinkansen to Okayama, coach to Hiroshima.
days_detail.detail: The Hakutsuru sake museum, then the White Heron castle at Himeji. Board the Shinkansen for a 20-minute run to Okayama, then coach 160 km to Hiroshima.

days_detail.title: Hiroshima & Miyajima
days_detail.text: Miyajima's floating shrine, then the Peace Park.
days_detail.detail: Ferry to Miyajima for Itsukushima Shrine, then the Peace Memorial Park, museum and A-Bomb Dome.

days_detail.title: Hiroshima – Kintaikyo – Beppu
days_detail.text: The Kintaikyo Bridge, then the Hells of Beppu on Kyushu.
days_detail.detail: Stop at the five-arched Kintaikyo Bridge, cross to Kyushu and tour the seven 'Hells of Beppu': Sea Hell, Blood Pond Hell, the mud pools and the Tornado geyser. About 330 km.

days_detail.title: Beppu – Yufuin – Mt Aso – Kumamoto
days_detail.text: Onsen town, an active volcano, then Kumamoto.
days_detail.detail: Free time in the onsen town of Yufuin, then Mt Aso's vast caldera and the Kusasenri grassland with views of Nakadake, before Kumamoto. About 160 km.
days_detail.hotel: Hotel Route Inn or similar, Kumamoto

days_detail.title: Kumamoto – Yanagawa – Fukuoka
days_detail.text: Kumamoto Castle, Yanagawa's canals, Dazaifu shrine.
days_detail.detail: Kumamoto Castle, the 930 km of canals in Yanagawa ('the Venice of Kyushu'), and Dazaifu Tenmangu Shrine before arriving in Fukuoka. About 150 km.

days_detail.title: Fukuoka free day
days_detail.text: A free day in Kyushu's biggest city.
days_detail.detail: A free day: Fukuoka Castle, Hakata ramen, the Daibutsu.

days_detail.title: Fukuoka – Australia
days_detail.text: Transfer to the airport for the flight home.
days_detail.detail: Transfer to the airport for the flight home.

days_detail.title: Arrive Australia
days_detail.detail: Arrive home.

name: Vietnam & Cambodia Discovery
stops: Overnight junk-boat cruise on the bay
Sung Sot Cave, cooking class, back to Hanoi
Fly Hanoi–Da Nang; walking tour; free day
Fly Da Nang–HCMC; Cu Chi Tunnels; free day
Shared bus via Moc Bai border; free day
Shared bus; full-day Angkor tour; fly home

images.caption: The emerald waters of Ha Long Bay
The ancient town of Hoi An
Floating fishing villages in Ha Long Bay

days_detail.title: Australia – Hanoi
days_detail.text: Fly to Hanoi and transfer to the hotel.
days_detail.detail: Fly to Hanoi; met on arrival and transferred to the hotel.
days_detail.hotel: Flower Garden Hotel or similar, Hanoi

days_detail.title: Hanoi – Ha Long Bay overnight cruise
days_detail.text: Drive to Ha Long Bay and board a traditional junk for the night.
days_detail.detail: About 180 km through rice country to Ha Long Bay. Board a junk-style boat for an overnight cruise among the limestone islands: seafood lunch, swimming or kayaking, a pearl farm, a cooking demonstration and dinner on board.
days_detail.hotel: Le Journey Cruise or similar (on board)

days_detail.title: Ha Long Bay – Hanoi
days_detail.text: Tai chi on deck, Sung Sot Cave, cooking class, return to Hanoi.
days_detail.detail: Optional sunrise tai chi, then a tender to Sung Sot ('Surprise') Cave, a spring-roll cooking class and light lunch before sailing back to port and driving to Hanoi.
days_detail.hotel: Flower Garden Hotel or similar, Hanoi
days_detail.optional: Water puppet show & Vietnamese dinner ($60)

days_detail.title: Hanoi – Hoi An
days_detail.text: Hanoi walking tour, then fly to Da Nang.
days_detail.detail: Morning walk through a local market, around West Lake, into Quan Thanh Taoist temple and the Cua Bach church. Afternoon flight to Da Nang and transfer to Hoi An.
days_detail.hotel: Le Pavillon Luxury Resort or similar, Hoi An

days_detail.title: Hoi An walking tour
days_detail.text: Old-town walking tour; free afternoon.
days_detail.detail: Museum of History and Culture, the 1590s Japanese Covered Bridge, the central market, Phuc Kien Assembly Hall and the 200-year-old Tan Ky house. Afternoon free.
days_detail.hotel: Le Pavillon Luxury Resort or similar, Hoi An
days_detail.optional: Market tour & cooking class at Tra Que village ($60)

days_detail.title: Hoi An free day
days_detail.text: A free day in Hoi An.
days_detail.detail: A free day, or the optional trip to Ba Na Hills by cable car for the Golden Bridge, the French wine cellar and gardens, with lunch.
days_detail.hotel: Le Pavillon Luxury Resort or similar, Hoi An
days_detail.optional: Ba Na Hills & Golden Bridge full day ($170)

days_detail.title: Hoi An – Ho Chi Minh City
days_detail.text: Fly from Da Nang to Ho Chi Minh City.
days_detail.detail: Transfer to Da Nang airport for the flight south to Ho Chi Minh City. Rest of the day free.
days_detail.hotel: Muong Thanh Saigon Centre or similar

days_detail.title: Cu Chi Tunnels
days_detail.text: The Cu Chi Tunnels, 60 km from the city.
days_detail.detail: Drive to the Cu Chi Tunnels and walk a section of the network that once held hospitals, kitchens and command posts. Drop-off at the hotel or the War Remnants Museum.
days_detail.hotel: Muong Thanh Saigon Centre or similar

days_detail.title: Ho Chi Minh City free day
days_detail.text: A free day, or the Mekong Delta.
days_detail.detail: Free day, or the optional Mekong Delta trip: motor boat from My Tho, canoes through the small canals, fruit and music at a village home, lunch on an islet.
days_detail.hotel: Muong Thanh Saigon Centre or similar
days_detail.optional: Mekong Delta day tour ($80)

days_detail.title: Ho Chi Minh City – Phnom Penh
days_detail.text: Shared bus across the Moc Bai border to Phnom Penh.
days_detail.detail: Early pick-up for the 230 km shared tourist bus to Cambodia, with visa processing at the Moc Bai / Bavet border; six to eight hours. A flight upgrade is available. Free afternoon.
days_detail.hotel: The Onra Hotel or similar, Phnom Penh
days_detail.optional: Flight upgrade instead of the bus ($280)

days_detail.title: Phnom Penh free day
days_detail.text: A free day in the capital.
days_detail.detail: Free day, or the optional city tour: Central Market, Independence Monument, Wat Ounalom, the Tuol Sleng museum and Choeung Ek killing fields, then the Royal Palace and Silver Pagoda.
days_detail.hotel: The Onra Hotel or similar, Phnom Penh
days_detail.optional: Choeung Ek & Phnom Penh city tour ($120)

days_detail.title: Phnom Penh – Siem Reap
days_detail.text: Shared bus 320 km to Siem Reap.
days_detail.detail: An early start for the shared bus north through Kandal, Kampong Cham and Kampong Thom provinces to Siem Reap. Afternoon free.
days_detail.hotel: Tara Angkor Hotel or similar, Siem Reap

days_detail.title: Temples of Angkor
days_detail.text: A full day at Angkor Wat, Angkor Thom and Ta Prohm.
days_detail.detail: The south gate of Angkor Thom, the Terrace of Elephants and Terrace of the Leper King, lunch, then jungle-wrapped Ta Prohm and finally Angkor Wat itself.
days_detail.hotel: Tara Angkor Hotel or similar, Siem Reap

days_detail.title: Siem Reap – Australia
days_detail.text: Transfer to the airport for the flight home.
days_detail.detail: Transfer to Siem Reap airport for the flight home; packed breakfast for early departures.

days_detail.title: Arrive Australia
days_detail.detail: Arrive home.

days_detail.title: Australia – Hanoi
days_detail.text: Fly to Hanoi and transfer to the hotel.
days_detail.detail: Fly to Hanoi; met and transferred to the hotel.
days_detail.hotel: Flower Garden Hotel or similar, Hanoi

days_detail.title: Hanoi walking tour
days_detail.text: A local market, West Lake, Quan Thanh temple.
days_detail.detail: A morning walk through a local market and around West Lake, into the Taoist temple of Quan Thanh and the French-built Cua Bach church. Afternoon free.
days_detail.hotel: Flower Garden Hotel or similar, Hanoi

days_detail.title: Hanoi – Ha Long Bay overnight cruise
days_detail.text: Board a traditional junk for a night among the karsts.
days_detail.detail: About 180 km to Ha Long Bay and aboard a junk-style boat: seafood lunch, swimming or kayaking, a pearl farm, a cooking demonstration and dinner at anchor among the limestone islands.
days_detail.hotel: Le Journey Cruise or similar (on board)

days_detail.title: Ha Long Bay – Hanoi
days_detail.text: Sung Sot Cave, cooking class, back to Hanoi.
days_detail.detail: Tender to Sung Sot ('Surprise') Cave, a spring-roll cooking class and light lunch, then back to port and 180 km to Hanoi.
days_detail.hotel: Flower Garden Hotel or similar, Hanoi
days_detail.optional: Water puppet show & Vietnamese dinner ($60)

days_detail.title: Hanoi – Hoa Lu – Tam Coc
days_detail.text: The ancient capital, then a bamboo boat through Tam Coc.
days_detail.detail: Drive to Ninh Binh province for the 10th-century temples of Hoa Lu, lunch, then a two-hour bamboo boat ride on the Hoang Long River through the three caves of Tam Coc.
days_detail.hotel: The Reed Hotel or similar, Ninh Binh

days_detail.title: Trang An & Bich Dong Pagoda
days_detail.text: 'Ha Long Bay on land' by boat, then a cliffside pagoda.
days_detail.detail: Another two-hour boat trip through the UNESCO-listed Trang An grottoes, lunch, then the tiered Bich Dong Pagoda built into the Truong Yen cliffs.
days_detail.hotel: The Reed Hotel or similar, Ninh Binh

days_detail.title: Ninh Binh – Pu Luong
days_detail.text: Phat Diem church, then into the nature reserve.
days_detail.detail: Stop at the stone cathedral of Phat Diem, then drive into Pu Luong Nature Reserve: terraced rice, limestone peaks and Thai villages. Hillside resorts mean stairs to your room.
days_detail.hotel: Pu Luong Eco Garden or similar

days_detail.title: Kho Muong & Ban Don villages
days_detail.text: Thai villages and a mountain hike.
days_detail.detail: A short drive to the traditional Thai villages of Kho Muong and Ban Don above the terraces, then a leisurely hike in the reserve looking for caves and waterfalls. Some steep sections; a pool day is the alternative.
days_detail.hotel: Pu Luong Eco Garden or similar

days_detail.title: Hieu Waterfall
days_detail.text: An easy trek through rice terraces to Hieu Waterfall.
days_detail.detail: Trek from Hieu village along the terraces and through jungle to Hieu Waterfall for a swim, then back to the retreat.
days_detail.hotel: Pu Luong Eco Garden or similar

days_detail.title: Pu Luong – Hanoi
days_detail.text: A slow morning, then back to Hanoi.
days_detail.detail: A relaxed morning at the resort before the drive back to Hanoi. Afternoon free.
days_detail.hotel: Flower Garden Hotel or similar, Hanoi

days_detail.title: Hanoi – Australia
days_detail.text: Morning free, then the flight home.
days_detail.detail: Morning at leisure, then transfer to the airport.

days_detail.title: Arrive Australia
days_detail.detail: Arrive home.

stops: Three nights at leisure; embark Royal Caribbean
Port day, then day at sea
Disembark 7am, own way to the airport

days_detail.title: Australia – Singapore
days_detail.text: Fly to Singapore and make your own way to the hotel.
days_detail.detail: Fly to Singapore; make your own way (or take the optional private transfer) to the hotel.
days_detail.hotel: Copthorne King's Hotel or similar, Singapore
days_detail.optional: Private airport transfer ($70 pp)

days_detail.title: Singapore free day
days_detail.text: Gardens by the Bay, Chinatown, Little India, Orchard Road.
days_detail.detail: A free day: the Merlion, Gardens by the Bay's Cloud Forest, Chinatown and Little India, Orchard Road, and a hawker centre for chicken rice or laksa.
days_detail.hotel: Copthorne King's Hotel or similar, Singapore

days_detail.title: Singapore free day
days_detail.text: A second free day.
days_detail.detail: Another free day in Singapore.
days_detail.hotel: Copthorne King's Hotel or similar, Singapore

days_detail.title: Embark
days_detail.text: Board your Royal Caribbean ship; sail at 4pm.
days_detail.detail: Make your own way to the cruise terminal to board Navigator of the Seas (Jan–Mar) or Quantum of the Seas (from Oct), sailing at 4pm.

days_detail.title: Penang, Malaysia
days_detail.text: George Town's UNESCO zone, 2:30pm to 9pm.
days_detail.detail: Walk from the port into George Town's heritage zone: Fort Cornwallis, the Goddess of Mercy temple, or the funicular up Penang Hill and Batu Ferringhi beach.

days_detail.title: Phuket, Thailand
days_detail.text: Beaches, elephants and James Bond Island, 8am to 8pm.
days_detail.detail: A tender day in Phuket: Kata Noi beach, the elephant sanctuary, Monkey Hill or a boat to James Bond Island in Phang Nga Bay.

days_detail.title: At sea
days_detail.text: A day at sea in the Strait of Malacca.
days_detail.detail: A day at sea: the FlowRider, waterslides, North Star or RipCord depending on the ship.

days_detail.title: Disembark – Australia
days_detail.text: Disembark 7am and make your own way to the airport.
days_detail.detail: Disembark in Singapore after breakfast and make your own way to the airport.
days_detail.optional: Private transfer port to airport ($70 pp)

days_detail.title: Arrive Australia
days_detail.detail: Welcome home.

name: Japan Explorer Cruise
stops: Own way to the port; embark Diamond Princess
Disembark 6:30am; own way to the airport

days_detail.title: Australia – Tokyo
days_detail.text: Fly to Tokyo and make your own way to the hotel.
days_detail.detail: Fly to Tokyo; own way (or optional private transfer) to the Shinagawa Prince Hotel for three nights.
days_detail.hotel: Shinagawa Prince Hotel or similar, Tokyo
days_detail.optional: Private airport transfer ($159 pp)

days_detail.title: Tokyo free day
days_detail.text: A free day in Tokyo.

days_detail.title: At sea

days_detail.detail: A day at sea; the Izumi Japanese bath is the largest of its kind afloat.

days_detail.title: Hakodate
days_detail.text: Hokkaido's historic port, 7am to 4pm.
days_detail.detail: Hakodate's Motomachi district of Western-style houses, the star-shaped Goryokaku fort and the Morning Market's sea urchin and crab.

days_detail.title: Niigata
days_detail.text: Rice, sake and craftsmanship, 9am to 6pm.
days_detail.detail: Niigata, Japan's sake heartland on the Sea of Japan; the Suwada open factory and Yahiko Shrine are nearby.

days_detail.title: At sea
days_detail.text: A day at sea across the Sea of Japan.
days_detail.detail: A day at sea towards Korea.

days_detail.title: Busan, South Korea
days_detail.text: Korea's second city, 7am to 4pm.
days_detail.detail: Busan: Yongdusan Park, the Haedong Yonggungsa seaside temple, Gamcheon Culture Village and the UN Memorial Cemetery.

days_detail.title: Nagasaki
days_detail.text: The 'San Francisco of Japan', 7am to 4pm.
days_detail.detail: Nagasaki's Peace Park and Atomic Bomb Museum, and the hillside city that was Japan's only window on the world for two centuries.

days_detail.title: Kagoshima
days_detail.text: Samurai history and the Sakurajima volcano, 7am to 4pm.
days_detail.detail: Kagoshima, stronghold of the Shimazu clan, facing the smoking cone of Sakurajima across the bay; hot springs all around.

days_detail.title: Kochi
days_detail.text: Shikoku's castle town, 9am to 5pm.
days_detail.detail: Kochi and its 1611 castle, Sakamoto Ryoma's home town, with a subtropical coast beyond.

days_detail.title: Shimizu (for Mt Fuji)
days_detail.text: Port for Mt Fuji, 1pm to 7pm.
days_detail.detail: Shimizu Port, about 13 km from Shizuoka and 75 km from the Mt Fuji viewing stations; shore excursions available.

days_detail.title: Yokohama – Australia

days_detail.title: Miyazaki (Aburatsu)

days_detail.title: Kagoshima

days_detail.detail: A day at sea heading south-west to Taiwan.

days_detail.title: Keelung (for Taipei), Taiwan

name: Rockies Rail & Cruise
stops: Free day or Icefields Parkway option
Port day, then day at sea

days_detail.title: Australia – Calgary
days_detail.text: Fly to Calgary and make your own way to the hotel.
days_detail.detail: Fly to Calgary. Transfers aren't included on arrival, so make your own way to the airport hotel.
days_detail.hotel: Country Inn & Suites Calgary Airport or similar

days_detail.title: Calgary – Lake Louise – Banff – Canmore
days_detail.text: Lake Louise, Banff National Park sightseeing, overnight in Canmore.
days_detail.detail: An early start west into the Rockies. See Lake Louise, then a sightseeing tour of Banff National Park before settling into Canmore, the quieter town just outside the park gate.

days_detail.title: Canmore free day
days_detail.text: Free day, or the Icefields Parkway.
days_detail.detail: A free day in Canmore. The optional Icefields Parkway trip takes you north past Bow Lake and Peyto Lake to the Athabasca Glacier for a ride onto the ice in an Ice Explorer.
days_detail.optional: Icefields Parkway with the Columbia Icefield Ice Explorer

days_detail.title: Banff – Kamloops on the Rocky Mountaineer
days_detail.text: Rocky Mountaineer day one: Continental Divide, Spiral Tunnels, Kicking Horse Canyon.
days_detail.detail: Board the Rocky Mountaineer at Banff. The route crosses the Continental Divide, loops through the Spiral Tunnels and follows the Kicking Horse River before descending into the dry interior at Kamloops.
days_detail.hotel: DoubleTree by Hilton Kamloops or similar

days_detail.title: Kamloops – Vancouver
days_detail.text: Rocky Mountaineer day two through the Fraser Canyon.
days_detail.detail: Second rail day: the Thompson River, Hell's Gate and the Fraser Canyon, then into the Fraser Valley and Vancouver.

days_detail.title: Embark Inside Passage cruise
days_detail.text: Board Holland America's Koningsdam at Canada Place.
days_detail.detail: Free morning in Vancouver, then board the Koningsdam at Canada Place. The ship sails in the late afternoon under the Lions Gate Bridge.

days_detail.title: Cruising the Inside Passage
days_detail.text: A day at sea through the fjords.
days_detail.detail: At sea threading the sheltered channels of the Inside Passage. Whales, eagles and the occasional bear on shore are all possible from the deck.

days_detail.title: Juneau
days_detail.text: Alaska's capital: glaciers, whales and floatplanes.
days_detail.detail: A day in Juneau, reachable only by sea or air. Mendenhall Glacier, whale-watching boats and floatplane flights over the icefield are the usual shore excursions.
days_detail.optional: Shore excursions: Mendenhall Glacier, whale watching, helicopter or floatplane

days_detail.title: Skagway
days_detail.text: Klondike gold-rush town and the White Pass railway.
days_detail.detail: Skagway's boardwalks and false-front storefronts date from the 1898 gold rush. The White Pass & Yukon Route railway climbs the same pass the prospectors walked.
days_detail.optional: White Pass & Yukon Route railway

days_detail.title: Glacier Bay National Park
days_detail.text: Scenic cruising among tidewater glaciers.
days_detail.detail: Scenic cruising in Glacier Bay with park rangers on board (Endicott Arm and Dawes Glacier on some sailings). Expect calving ice and seals on the floes.

days_detail.title: Ketchikan
days_detail.text: Alaska's 'First City': totems, Tlingit culture, salmon.
days_detail.detail: Ketchikan is built on stilts over the water. Totem poles, Creek Street and Tlingit heritage sites are within walking distance of the dock.
days_detail.optional: Misty Fjords flightseeing, salmon fishing

days_detail.title: Cruising the Inside Passage
days_detail.text: Second day at sea heading south.
days_detail.detail: A final sea day heading south through the Inside Passage towards Vancouver.

days_detail.title: Vancouver – Australia
days_detail.text: Disembark and make your own way to the airport.
days_detail.detail: Disembark in Vancouver and make your own way to the airport for the flight home.

days_detail.detail: In transit.

days_detail.detail: Arrive home.

name: Alaska & Canada Discovery
stops: Free day or Icefields Parkway option

days_detail.title: Australia – Calgary
days_detail.text: Fly to Calgary and make your own way to the hotel.
days_detail.detail: Fly to Calgary; transfers aren't included, so make your own way to the airport hotel. Check-in from 3pm with luggage storage for early arrivals.
days_detail.hotel: Country Inn & Suites Calgary Airport or similar

days_detail.title: Calgary – Lake Louise – Banff – Canmore
days_detail.text: Lake Louise, a Banff sightseeing tour, then Canmore.
days_detail.detail: Early meet-up, then about 190 km west to Lake Louise for time on the lakeshore and a look inside the Fairmont Chateau. Continue to Banff for the Bow River, the Hoodoos and Bow Falls, finishing in Canmore.

days_detail.title: Canmore free day
days_detail.text: Free day, or the Icefields Parkway.
days_detail.detail: A free day in Canmore, or the optional 420 km return trip along the Icefields Parkway past Crowfoot Glacier, Bow Summit and Mistaya Canyon to the Athabasca Glacier for an Ice Explorer ride.
days_detail.optional: Jasper National Park & Columbia Icefield ($300 pp)

days_detail.title: Canmore – Kamloops
days_detail.text: A big drive through three national parks to Kamloops.
days_detail.detail: About 600 km and eight hours through Yoho, Glacier and Mount Revelstoke national parks, stopping at Eagle Pass for the 'Last Spike' of the transcontinental railway. Overnight in the Kamloops / Sun Peaks area.

days_detail.title: Kamloops – Whistler
days_detail.text: The Cariboo Wagon Trail to Whistler.
days_detail.detail: Follow the old Gold Rush route along the Cariboo Wagon Trail, about 300 km, into the alpine village of Whistler beneath Blackcomb Mountain.

days_detail.title: Whistler free day
days_detail.text: A free day in Whistler.
days_detail.detail: A full day at leisure in Whistler: the village, the Peak 2 Peak gondola, or the lakes and trails.

days_detail.title: Whistler – Vancouver, embark
days_detail.text: Vancouver city tour, then board the Koningsdam.
days_detail.detail: Drive about 120 km to Vancouver for a tour of Chinatown, Gastown and Stanley Park, then board Holland America's Koningsdam at Canada Place and sail in the afternoon.

days_detail.title: Inside Passage, scenic cruising
days_detail.text: A day at sea through the Inside Passage.
days_detail.detail: At sea through the glacier-cut fjords and rainforest of the Inside Passage. Humpbacks, orca, bald eagles and shoreline bears are all possible.

days_detail.title: Juneau
days_detail.text: Alaska's remote capital, 1:30pm to 10pm.
days_detail.detail: Docked from early afternoon until late evening. Hike Mount Roberts, take a whale-watching boat to Auke Bay, or a floatplane to see bears on Admiralty Island.
days_detail.optional: Whale watching, Mendenhall Glacier, floatplane bear viewing

days_detail.title: Skagway
days_detail.text: Gold-rush town, 7am to 8pm.
days_detail.detail: A full day in the Klondike gateway: the historic district, the Red Onion Saloon and the White Pass & Yukon Route railway into the mountains.
days_detail.optional: White Pass & Yukon Route railway

days_detail.title: Glacier Bay, scenic cruising
days_detail.text: Tidewater glaciers from the deck, 6:15am to 3:15pm.
days_detail.detail: A morning and early afternoon among Glacier Bay's seven tidewater glaciers with park rangers aboard. Dress for rain and bring binoculars. (Endicott Arm on the 25 April sailing.)

days_detail.title: Ketchikan
days_detail.text: Alaska's First City, 11am to 7pm.
days_detail.detail: Totem poles at the Totem Heritage Center and Totem Bight, Tlingit culture at Saxman Village, and salmon everywhere.
days_detail.optional: Misty Fjords flightseeing, sportfishing

days_detail.title: Inside Passage, scenic cruising
days_detail.text: Second sea day heading south.
days_detail.detail: A final day at sea through the Inside Passage back towards Vancouver.

days_detail.title: Vancouver – Australia
days_detail.text: Disembark 7am and make your own way to the airport.
days_detail.detail: Disembark after breakfast and make your own way to the airport; luggage storage is available at the port and airport.

days_detail.title: Australia – Seattle
days_detail.text: Fly to Seattle and make your own way to the hotel.
days_detail.detail: Fly to Seattle; own transfer to the hotel.

days_detail.title: Seattle – Kellogg, Idaho
days_detail.text: Across Washington's wheat and wine country to Idaho.
days_detail.detail: About 590 km east through eastern Washington's rolling farmland and wine country, past the Columbia Gorge on the old Lewis and Clark route, to the mining town of Kellogg.

days_detail.title: Kellogg – Yellowstone
days_detail.text: Cowboy country to the world's first national park.
days_detail.detail: A 680 km drive through Montana's gold-rush rivers and ranch country into Yellowstone. First look at the geysers, mud pots and hot springs, then overnight at Gardiner or West Yellowstone.
days_detail.hotel: Big Rock Inn or similar, Yellowstone area

days_detail.title: Yellowstone National Park
days_detail.text: A full day in Yellowstone.
days_detail.detail: A second day in the park; your guide chooses the route by weather and conditions. Old Faithful, Grand Prismatic Spring and the Lamar Valley wildlife are the usual targets.
days_detail.hotel: Big Rock Inn or similar, Yellowstone area

days_detail.title: Yellowstone – Great Falls
days_detail.text: Early wildlife drive, then north to Great Falls.
days_detail.detail: An early start for wildlife, then leave the park and drive about 360 km north through mountains and national forest to Great Falls, Montana.
days_detail.hotel: The Great Falls Inn or similar

days_detail.title: Great Falls – Canmore, Canada
days_detail.text: Cross the border into the Rockies.
days_detail.detail: About 650 km north across the Canadian border into increasingly mountainous country, arriving in Canmore with the evening free.

days_detail.title: Lake Louise & Banff
days_detail.text: Lake Louise, then a Banff sightseeing tour.
days_detail.detail: Time at Lake Louise and the Fairmont Chateau, then Banff for the Bow River, the Hoodoos and Bow Falls before returning to Canmore.

days_detail.title: Canmore free day
days_detail.text: Free day, or the Icefields Parkway.
days_detail.detail: A free day, or the optional Icefields Parkway trip to the Columbia Icefield and an Ice Explorer ride on the Athabasca Glacier (about 460 km).
days_detail.optional: Jasper National Park & Columbia Icefield ($300 pp)

days_detail.title: Canmore – Abbotsford
days_detail.text: Nine hours through three national parks to the Fraser Valley.
days_detail.detail: The long day: about 890 km through Yoho, Glacier and Mount Revelstoke national parks, the 'Last Spike' at Eagle Pass, then down to the Abbotsford / Chilliwack area.

days_detail.title: Vancouver, embark
days_detail.text: Vancouver city tour, then board your Princess ship.
days_detail.detail: Drive into Vancouver for Chinatown, Gastown and Stanley Park, then board at Canada Place for the seven-night Alaska cruise (Crown, Discovery or Emerald Princess by date).

days_detail.title: At sea
days_detail.text: A day at sea in Alaskan waters.
days_detail.detail: A day at sea with whales, orca and eagles possible from the deck.

days_detail.title: Juneau
days_detail.text: Alaska's capital: glaciers, gold-rush history, indigenous culture.
days_detail.detail: A day in Juneau, founded on an 1880 gold strike and now known for Mendenhall Glacier, whale watching and Tlingit culture.
days_detail.optional: Shore excursions

days_detail.title: Skagway
days_detail.text: The Klondike gateway and the White Pass railway.
days_detail.detail: Skagway's restored Broadway Avenue, local Tlingit culture and the vintage White Pass & Yukon Route railway.
days_detail.optional: White Pass & Yukon Route railway

days_detail.title: Endicott Arm & Dawes Glacier
days_detail.text: Scenic cruising to a calving tidewater glacier.
days_detail.detail: Cruise 48 km into the Endicott Arm fjord to the calving face of Dawes Glacier, past waterfalls, icebergs, seals and bears. (Glacier Bay on the 9 and 16 May sailings.)

days_detail.title: Ketchikan
days_detail.text: The Salmon Capital of the World.
days_detail.detail: Ketchikan's totem poles at the Totem Heritage Center, Haida, Tlingit and Tsimshian heritage, and salmon everywhere.

days_detail.title: Inside Passage, scenic cruising
days_detail.text: A last day at sea heading south.
days_detail.detail: A final day cruising the Inside Passage back towards Vancouver.

days_detail.detail: Disembark after breakfast and make your own way to the airport.

name: Ultimate South American Adventure
stops: Train and road back to Cusco
Andean road with stops; Lake Titicaca
City tour, tango dinner, free day
Brazilian side, then fly to Rio; Christ the Redeemer

days_detail.title: Australia – Lima
days_detail.text: Fly to Lima and transfer to the hotel.
days_detail.detail: Fly to Lima, the 'City of Kings'; met and transferred to the hotel. Perth departures may leave two days early.
days_detail.hotel: Hotel Jose Antonio Executive or similar

days_detail.title: Lima city tour
days_detail.text: Huaca Pucllana, the historic centre and the San Francisco catacombs.
days_detail.detail: A morning at the pre-Inca Huaca Pucllana, then the UNESCO-listed centre: Plaza de Armas, the Government Palace and cathedral, and the Convent of San Francisco with its 25,000-volume library and bone-lined catacombs.
days_detail.hotel: Hotel Jose Antonio Executive or similar

days_detail.title: Lima – Puerto Maldonado – Amazon
days_detail.text: Fly to the Amazon and boat to your lodge.
days_detail.detail: Fly to Puerto Maldonado, store your main bag in town and take a motor boat (30 minutes to two hours) to the lodge. Lunch, then a first walk or boat trip into the forest.

days_detail.title: Amazon Jungle
days_detail.text: A full day of jungle walks and boat trips.
days_detail.detail: Walks and boat excursions around oxbow lakes and side channels with your Amazon guide: monkeys, birdlife, caimans, capybara and, with luck, giant river otters.

days_detail.title: Amazon – Cusco
days_detail.text: Boat back to town, fly to Cusco.
days_detail.detail: Return by river to Puerto Maldonado and fly to Cusco at 3,399 m. Rest of the day free to acclimatise.

days_detail.title: Cusco city tour
days_detail.text: Koricancha, the cathedral, Sacsayhuaman, Qenqo and Tambomachay.
days_detail.detail: A half-day through Inca and colonial Cusco: the gold-walled Koricancha, the cathedral on the Plaza de Armas, then the fortress of Sacsayhuaman, the Qenqo labyrinth and the Inca baths at Tambomachay above the city.

days_detail.title: Cusco free day
days_detail.text: A free day, or Maras & Moray or Rainbow Mountain.
days_detail.detail: A free day in the old Inca capital. Optional half-day to the Moray terraces and Maras salt pans, or the full-day Rainbow Mountain trek to 5,036 m (one or the other), plus a folklore dinner show in the evening.
days_detail.optional: Maras & Moray; Rainbow Mountain trek; folklore dinner & show

days_detail.title: Sacred Valley of the Incas
days_detail.text: Pisac market and ruins, then Ollantaytambo.
days_detail.detail: Over the mountains into the Sacred Valley: Pisac's market and hilltop ruins, lunch in Urubamba, then Ollantaytambo's Temple of the Sun and living Inca town. Pack an 8 kg bag for the train tomorrow.
days_detail.hotel: San Agustin Monasterio de la Recoleta or similar, Urubamba

days_detail.title: Peru Expedition Train – Aguas Calientes
days_detail.text: Train along the Urubamba to the foot of Machu Picchu.
days_detail.detail: Board the Peru Expedition Train at Ollantaytambo for the ride along the Urubamba River into cloud forest and the pedestrian town of Aguas Calientes. Hot springs and markets; early night.
days_detail.hotel: Hatun Inti Boutique or similar, Aguas Calientes
days_detail.optional: Express Inca Trail trek from Km 104 via Wiñay Wayna to the Sun Gate

days_detail.title: Machu Picchu
days_detail.text: Sunrise at the citadel, then train and road to Cusco.
days_detail.detail: Bus up at 5:40am for a two-hour guided tour: the House of the Guardian, Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun and the Sacred Plaza. Back down for lunch, then train to Poroy and road to Cusco, arriving about 7pm.
days_detail.hotel: San Agustin Plaza or similar, Cusco

days_detail.title: Cusco – Puno
days_detail.text: The Andean road to Lake Titicaca with stops.
days_detail.detail: A 7am bus south with stops at the painted chapel of Andahuaylillas, the Temple of Wiracocha at Raqchi, a buffet lunch, La Raya Pass at 4,335 m and the Pukara museum, arriving in Puno about 5pm.
days_detail.hotel: Hotel Jose Antonio Puno or similar
days_detail.optional: Andean Explorer-style train upgrade (selected days)

days_detail.title: Lake Titicaca & the Uros Islands
days_detail.text: The reed islands of the Uros, then Taquile Island.
days_detail.detail: Motorboat to the floating totora-reed islands of the Uros, then on to Taquile for a walk across the island, a family visit and lunch before returning to Puno.
days_detail.hotel: Hotel Jose Antonio Puno or similar

days_detail.title: Puno – Lima
days_detail.text: Fly from Juliaca back to Lima.
days_detail.detail: Transfer to Juliaca airport for the flight to Lima. Rest of the day free.
days_detail.hotel: Hotel Jose Antonio Lima or similar

days_detail.title: Lima – Buenos Aires
days_detail.text: Fly to Argentina.
days_detail.detail: Fly from Lima to Buenos Aires and transfer to a central hotel.

days_detail.title: Buenos Aires city tour & tango
days_detail.text: Plaza de Mayo, San Telmo, La Boca, Recoleta, then a tango dinner.
days_detail.detail: A morning through Plaza de Mayo, the Casa Rosada, San Telmo's cobbles, La Boca's Caminito and Recoleta Cemetery with Evita's grave. Evening three-course dinner and tango show at Aljibe Tango in San Telmo.

days_detail.title: Buenos Aires free day
days_detail.text: A free day, or a gaucho ranch day.
days_detail.detail: Free day in the city, or the optional full day at a traditional estancia: horse riding, an asado lunch, folk music and a gaucho skills display.
days_detail.optional: Gaucho full-day ranch experience

days_detail.title: Buenos Aires – Iguazu Falls
days_detail.text: Fly to Puerto Iguazu.
days_detail.detail: Fly north to Puerto Iguazu on the Argentinian side of the falls. Afternoon free.
days_detail.hotel: El Pueblito Theme Hotel or similar

days_detail.title: Iguazu Falls, Argentinian side
days_detail.text: A day on the walkways above the falls.
days_detail.detail: Guided day in Iguazu National Park on the raised jungle walkways to the Devil's Throat and the upper and lower circuits.
days_detail.hotel: El Pueblito Theme Hotel or similar
days_detail.optional: The Great Adventure boat tour under the falls (about US$100)

days_detail.title: Iguazu, Brazilian side – Rio de Janeiro
days_detail.text: The Brazilian panorama, then fly to Rio.
days_detail.detail: Cross into Brazil for the half-day panoramic circuit of the canyon, Salto Rivadavia and the Devil's Throat, then fly from Foz do Iguaçu to Rio de Janeiro.
days_detail.hotel: Windsor Plaza Hotel or similar, Rio

days_detail.title: Christ the Redeemer
days_detail.text: Corcovado and the Selarón Stairs.
days_detail.detail: Up Corcovado to Christ the Redeemer (renovation scaffolding possible until July 2027, with 220 steps in place of the lifts), then Jorge Selarón's tiled staircase in Lapa.
days_detail.hotel: Windsor Plaza Hotel or similar, Rio

days_detail.title: Rio free day
days_detail.text: A free day, or Sugar Loaf.
days_detail.detail: A free day for Copacabana and Ipanema, or the optional half-day city tour with the cable car up Sugar Loaf Mountain.
days_detail.hotel: Windsor Plaza Hotel or similar, Rio
days_detail.optional: City tour & Sugar Loaf Mountain

days_detail.title: Rio – Australia
days_detail.text: Transfer to the airport for the flight home.
days_detail.detail: Transfer to the airport for the flight home.

days_detail.title: Australia – Cairo
days_detail.text: Depart for Cairo.
days_detail.detail: Depart Australia for Cairo; some flights arrive the next day.

days_detail.title: Welcome to Cairo
days_detail.text: Arrive and transfer to the hotel.
days_detail.detail: Met at the airport and transferred to the hotel near the pyramids.
days_detail.hotel: Jaz Pyramids Resort or similar, Cairo

days_detail.title: Pyramids & Sphinx
days_detail.text: The Pyramids of Giza, the Sphinx and the Valley Temple.
days_detail.detail: With an Egyptologist guide: the Great Pyramid of Khufu, the Valley Temple, Chephren's pyramid and the Sphinx, then the Papyrus Institute, or swap in the new Grand Egyptian Museum.
days_detail.hotel: Jaz Pyramids Resort or similar, Cairo
days_detail.optional: Grand Egyptian Museum with Tutankhamun's treasures ($140)

days_detail.title: Egyptian Museum & Old Cairo
days_detail.text: The Egyptian Museum, Tahrir Square and Coptic Cairo.
days_detail.detail: A guided morning in the Egyptian Museum's 5,000 years of treasures, then through Tahrir Square to Coptic Cairo: the Babylon Fortress, the Hanging Church and St Sergius. Evening free.
days_detail.hotel: Jaz Pyramids Resort or similar, Cairo
days_detail.optional: 5-star Dahabiya sailboat upgrade for the Nile ($1,100 pp)

days_detail.title: Cairo – Aswan, board the Nile cruise
days_detail.text: Fly to Aswan, see the High Dam and Unfinished Obelisk, board.
days_detail.detail: Fly to Aswan for the High Dam and the Unfinished Obelisk in its quarry, a perfume factory, then board the MS Nile Crown 1 (or similar) for lunch, the pool and a traditional dinner.
days_detail.hotel: MS Nile Crown 1 or similar (on board)

days_detail.title: Aswan – Kom Ombo
days_detail.text: Optional Abu Simbel, then sail to Kom Ombo.
days_detail.detail: A morning on board or the optional dawn coach to Abu Simbel's colossal Ramses II temples. Sail to Kom Ombo for the twin temples of Sobek and Horus, then on to Edfu with a galabeya party on board.
days_detail.hotel: MS Nile Crown 1 or similar (on board)
days_detail.optional: Abu Simbel guided tour ($150)

days_detail.title: Edfu – Luxor
days_detail.text: Temple of Horus at Edfu, then sail to Luxor.
days_detail.detail: Morning visit to the Temple of Horus at Edfu, then sail past Esna to Luxor with lunch on board and a belly dance and Tanoura show in the evening.
days_detail.hotel: MS Nile Crown 1 or similar (on board)

days_detail.title: Valley of the Kings, Karnak & Luxor
days_detail.text: The West Bank tombs, then Luxor and Karnak temples.
days_detail.detail: Disembark for the Valley of the Kings, the Temple of Hatshepsut and the Colossi of Memnon, then cross to the East Bank for Luxor Temple and the vast Karnak complex.
days_detail.hotel: Aracan Eatabe Hotel or similar, Luxor

days_detail.title: Luxor – Hurghada
days_detail.text: Transfer to a Red Sea beach resort.
days_detail.detail: Drive to Hurghada on the Red Sea for three nights at a beachfront resort.

days_detail.title: Hurghada free day
days_detail.text: A free day on the Red Sea.
days_detail.detail: A free day for the beach, snorkelling or diving on the reefs, or the Giftun Islands.

days_detail.title: Hurghada free day
days_detail.text: A second free day.
days_detail.detail: Another free day; desert safaris, submarine and boat trips can be booked at the resort.

days_detail.title: Hurghada – Cairo
days_detail.text: A five-hour road transfer back to Cairo.
days_detail.detail: About 465 km and five hours by road back to Cairo with rest stops. Evening free.
days_detail.hotel: Hotel Tolip El Galaa or similar, Cairo

days_detail.title: Cairo – Australia
days_detail.text: Transfer to the airport for the flight home.
days_detail.detail: Transfer to the airport; some flights leave in the early hours of Day 14.

days_detail.title: Arrive Australia
days_detail.detail: Arrive home.

name: Colours of Morocco
stops: Rabat tour, then the blue town
Volubilis en route; full-day Fes tour

images.caption: Camel trek on the dunes of Erg Chebbi

days_detail.title: Australia – Casablanca
days_detail.text: Depart for Casablanca.
days_detail.detail: Depart Australia for Casablanca.

days_detail.title: Casablanca – Rabat
days_detail.text: Arrive and drive to the capital.
days_detail.detail: Met at Casablanca airport and driven about an hour and a half to Rabat.
days_detail.hotel: ONOMO Hotel Rabat Terminus or similar

days_detail.title: Rabat – Chefchaouen
days_detail.text: Rabat's monuments, then the blue-washed town.
days_detail.detail: A guided morning in Rabat: the Kasbah des Oudaias, the Mausoleum of Mohammed V and Hassan Tower. Then about 250 km to Chefchaouen for a walking tour from the 18th-century Kasbah Museum through the blue lanes.
days_detail.hotel: Dar Echchaouen Maison d'Hôte & Riad or similar

days_detail.title: Chefchaouen – Volubilis – Fes
days_detail.text: Roman Volubilis through the Rif Mountains, then Fes.
days_detail.detail: Through the Rif to the UNESCO-listed Roman city of Volubilis and its mosaics, then on to Fes, with the view over the old city from the North Borj. About 250 km.
days_detail.hotel: Riad Marjana Suites & Spa or similar, Fes

days_detail.title: Fes full-day tour
days_detail.text: The world's oldest working medina.
days_detail.detail: A full day in Fes el-Bali: the 9th-century Karaouine, the carved cedar of Medersa Bou Inania, the souks and tanneries, then the Mellah, the Royal Palace gates and a viewpoint over the medina.
days_detail.hotel: Riad Marjana Suites & Spa or similar, Fes

days_detail.title: Fes – Merzouga
days_detail.text: Over the Middle Atlas to the edge of the Sahara.
days_detail.detail: A long 460 km day through the cedar forests near Ifrane and Azrou (Barbary macaques possible), over the Tizi n'Talremt pass, down the Ziz Gorge and valley past Erfoud to Merzouga at the foot of Erg Chebbi.

days_detail.title: Erg Chebbi: 4x4, camels & desert camp
days_detail.text: Dunes by 4x4, tea with nomads, Gnawa music, sunset camel ride.
days_detail.detail: 4x4 through the dunes, tea in a nomad family's tent, then Gnawa music and lunch at Khamlia village. In the afternoon ride a camel into the dunes to a Bedouin camp for sunset, dinner and music by the fire.
days_detail.hotel: Madu Desert Camp (private facilities) or similar

days_detail.title: Merzouga – Todgha Gorge – Boumalne Dades
days_detail.text: Rissani market, a Berber museum, the Todgha Gorge.
days_detail.detail: Optional sunrise on the dunes, then 4x4 back to Merzouga and 250 km via Rissani market and the Berber Oasis Museum at Khorbat to the ochre cliffs of Todgha Gorge and the Road of a Thousand Kasbahs.

days_detail.title: Boumalne Dades – Ouarzazate
days_detail.text: The Valley of Roses and lunch with a Berber family.
days_detail.detail: The Valley of Roses and the adobe village of Boutaghrar, lunch in a Berber family home, then 120 km to Ouarzazate.
days_detail.hotel: Riad Dar Chamaa or similar, Ouarzazate

days_detail.title: Ouarzazate – Ait Benhaddou – Taroudant
days_detail.text: The film-set kasbah, then across the Anti-Atlas.
days_detail.detail: Ait Benhaddou's UNESCO-listed ksar, then 290 km through the Anti-Atlas via the carpet town of Taznakht and saffron capital Taliouine to the walled city of Taroudant.
days_detail.hotel: Riad Dar Zitoune or similar, Taroudant

days_detail.title: Taroudant free day
days_detail.text: A free day in 'Little Marrakech'.
days_detail.detail: A free day inside Taroudant's ochre walls.
days_detail.hotel: Riad Dar Zitoune or similar, Taroudant

days_detail.title: Taroudant – Agadir – Essaouira
days_detail.text: The Atlantic coast to Essaouira.
days_detail.detail: About 260 km to the port of Agadir, then the coast road to Essaouira (old Mogador): the Skala du Port, the Jewish quarter and the silver craft centre.

days_detail.title: Essaouira – Marrakech
days_detail.text: A free morning, then to the red city.
days_detail.detail: Morning at leisure in Essaouira, then 180 km inland to Marrakech with the evening free.

days_detail.title: Marrakech city tour
days_detail.text: Koutoubia, the Saadian Tombs, Bahia Palace, Jemaa el-Fnaa.
days_detail.detail: A guided day through the Koutoubia Mosque, the Saadian Tombs, the Bahia Palace and into Jemaa el-Fnaa as the evening entertainment begins.
days_detail.optional: Carriage ride ($150); Chez Ali dinner & Fantasia show ($240); cooking class ($150)

days_detail.title: Marrakech – Casablanca
days_detail.text: The Hassan II Mosque.
days_detail.detail: Drive 240 km to Casablanca for the Hassan II Mosque and its 210 m minaret over the sea. Afternoon free.
days_detail.hotel: Hotel Odyssee Center or similar, Casablanca

days_detail.title: Casablanca – Australia
days_detail.text: Transfer to the airport.
days_detail.detail: Transfer to Casablanca airport for the flight home.

days_detail.title: Arrive Australia
days_detail.detail: Arrive home.

name: Italy, Türkiye & Greek Islands Cruise
stops: Own way to the port; embark Odyssey of the Seas
Disembark 5am, own way to Rome airport

images.caption: Royal Caribbean's Odyssey of the Seas
The ruins of Ephesus near Kuşadası

days_detail.title: Australia – Rome
days_detail.text: Fly to Rome.
days_detail.detail: Fly to Rome; some departures arrive the next day.

days_detail.title: Arrive in Rome
days_detail.text: Make your own way to a central hotel.
days_detail.detail: Arrive and make your own way (or take the optional private transfer) to a centrally located hotel.
days_detail.hotel: Hotel Diana Roof Garden or similar, Rome
days_detail.optional: Private airport transfer ($95 pp)

days_detail.title: Rome free day
days_detail.text: A free day: Trevi Fountain, Colosseum, Spanish Steps.
days_detail.detail: A free day in the Eternal City; the Trevi Fountain, Colosseum and Spanish Steps are all walkable.
days_detail.hotel: Hotel Diana Roof Garden or similar, Rome

days_detail.title: Rome free day
days_detail.text: A second free day: the Vatican and the Pantheon.
days_detail.detail: Another free day; St Peter's, the Sistine Chapel and the Pantheon are the obvious picks.
days_detail.hotel: Hotel Diana Roof Garden or similar, Rome

days_detail.title: Embark at Civitavecchia
days_detail.text: Make your own way to the port; sail at 3pm.
days_detail.detail: Free morning, then make your own way 75 km to Civitavecchia to board Royal Caribbean's Odyssey of the Seas, departing 3pm.
days_detail.optional: Private transfer hotel to port ($245 pp)

days_detail.title: At sea
days_detail.text: A day at sea.
days_detail.detail: A day at sea on a Quantum Ultra-class ship: pools, the North Star capsule, FlowRider and 15-plus dining venues.

days_detail.title: Santorini
days_detail.text: Whitewashed villages above the caldera, 9am to 11pm.
days_detail.detail: A long tender day on Santorini: cable car to Fira, Oia's blue domes, black-sand beaches or the Akrotiri excavations.
days_detail.optional: Royal Beach Club Santorini

days_detail.title: Kuşadası (Ephesus)
days_detail.text: Türkiye's coast and the ruins of Ephesus, 9am to 7pm.
days_detail.detail: Docked in Kuşadası; the ruins of Ephesus with its Great Theatre and Library of Celsus are a short excursion away.
days_detail.optional: Ephesus shore excursion

days_detail.title: Mykonos
days_detail.text: The Island of the Winds, 7am to 5pm.
days_detail.detail: A tender day on Mykonos: Chora's white lanes, the windmills and Little Venice.

days_detail.title: At sea
days_detail.text: A day at sea.
days_detail.detail: A day at sea heading west.

days_detail.title: Naples
days_detail.text: Pizza, palaces and Vesuvius, 7am to 6pm.
days_detail.detail: A day in Naples: the Royal Palace, the Sanità district, or excursions to Pompeii and the Amalfi Coast.

days_detail.title: Disembark – Rome – Australia
days_detail.text: Disembark 5am and make your own way to the airport.
days_detail.detail: Disembark at Civitavecchia after breakfast and make your own way about 65 km to Rome Fiumicino for the flight home.
days_detail.optional: Private transfer port to airport ($215 pp)

days_detail.title: Arrive Australia
days_detail.detail: Welcome home.

name: Iconic Northern Lights Rail & Sail
stops: Train north across the Arctic Circle; husky day
Snow Resort, king crab; Gamme cabin
Train to Voss, coach, Nærøyfjord ferry
Flåm Railway to Myrdal, train to Oslo; farewell dinner

images.caption: A night in a glass igloo

days_detail.title: Australia – Helsinki
days_detail.text: Fly to Helsinki.
days_detail.detail: Fly to Helsinki; make your own way to the airport.

days_detail.title: Arrive in Helsinki
days_detail.text: Make your own way to the hotel; welcome dinner.
days_detail.detail: Arrive in Helsinki, make your own way to the hotel (luggage storage for early arrivals), free afternoon and a welcome dinner with the group.
days_detail.hotel: Radisson Blu Plaza or similar, Helsinki
days_detail.optional: Private airport transfer

days_detail.title: Train to Rovaniemi
days_detail.text: Rail north into Finnish Lapland.
days_detail.detail: A short walk to the station and the train north through snowy forests to Rovaniemi, capital of Finnish Lapland, above the Arctic Circle. Afternoon free.
days_detail.hotel: Original Sokos Vaakuna or similar, Rovaniemi

days_detail.title: Husky experience
days_detail.text: A husky kennel and a sled or cart ride.
days_detail.detail: Meet the dogs at a husky kennel, light lunch, then a husky-drawn sled (or cart) ride through the wilderness. Evening free.
days_detail.hotel: Original Sokos Vaakuna or similar, Rovaniemi

days_detail.title: Santa Claus Village – Saariselkä
days_detail.text: Santa's village, then a glass igloo night.
days_detail.detail: A morning at Santa Claus Village, then north via Sodankylä's old church to Saariselkä. Meet a reindeer herder, dinner, and a night in an Aurora Cabin with a glass roof, far from any light pollution.
days_detail.hotel: Northern Lights Village Aurora Cabin, Saariselkä

days_detail.title: Inari – Kirkenes, Norway
days_detail.text: The Sami museum, then a king crab lunch at the Snow Resort.
days_detail.detail: Stop at Inari's SIIDA Sami museum, cross into Norway to the Snow Resort Kirkenes: reindeer, huskies, a king crab presentation on the pier and a crab lunch, then a night in a Gamme cabin.

days_detail.title: Embark Hurtigruten – Vardø – Berlevåg
days_detail.text: Board the Coastal Express in the Arctic.
days_detail.detail: Board the Hurtigruten Coastal Express at Kirkenes. Vardø's star fort, then Båtsfjord and Berlevåg on the Barents Sea; an overnight stop at Mehamn with an optional snowmobile ride.
days_detail.optional: Snowmobile in the polar night (15 Dec–30 Apr)

days_detail.title: Honningsvåg – Hammerfest – Tromsø
days_detail.text: Along the top of Norway to Tromsø.
days_detail.detail: Honningsvåg, gateway to the North Cape, then Hammerfest's Meridian Column, arriving in Tromsø late in the evening.
days_detail.optional: Midnight concert in Tromsø's Arctic Cathedral

days_detail.title: Lofoten & Vesterålen
days_detail.text: The Lofoten Wall and the Trollfjord.
days_detail.detail: Harstad, the Risøyrenna channel, Stokmarknes where Hurtigruten began, then the narrow Raftsund and (conditions permitting) the Trollfjord between thousand-metre cliffs.
days_detail.optional: A Taste of Vesterålen

days_detail.title: Brønnøysund
days_detail.text: Cross the Arctic Circle heading south.
days_detail.detail: Cross the Arctic Circle (cod liver oil optional), then the Helgeland coast: Torghatten with its hole and the Seven Sisters range.

days_detail.title: Trondheim
days_detail.text: Norway's first capital.
days_detail.detail: Time in Trondheim for Nidaros Cathedral, the cafés of Bakklandet and Kristiansten Fort; overnight calls at Kristiansund, Ålesund and Måløy.

days_detail.title: Bergen, disembark
days_detail.text: Nordfjord and Sognefjord, then a Bergen city tour.
days_detail.detail: Past the Jostedal Glacier and across the mouth of the Sognefjord to Bergen. Disembark for a tour of the UNESCO-listed Bryggen, St Mary's Church and Håkon's Hall, and the Fløibanen funicular up Mount Fløyen.
days_detail.hotel: Clarion Admiral Hotel or similar, Bergen

days_detail.title: Bergen – Nærøyfjord – Flåm
days_detail.text: Train, coach and fjord ferry to Flåm.
days_detail.detail: The 'Norway in a Nutshell' route: train to Voss, coach past waterfalls to Gudvangen, ferry along the narrow UNESCO-listed Nærøyfjord to the village of Flåm.

days_detail.title: Flåm Railway – Oslo
days_detail.text: One of the world's great rail journeys, then Oslo.
days_detail.detail: The Flåm Railway climbs 900 m to Myrdal, then the main line east to Oslo. Farewell dinner at the hotel.
days_detail.hotel: Thon Hotel Opera or similar, Oslo

days_detail.title: Oslo – Australia
days_detail.text: Make your own way to the airport.
days_detail.detail: Make your own way to Oslo airport for the flight home.
days_detail.optional: Private airport transfer

days_detail.title: Arrive Australia
days_detail.detail: Arrive home.
